title: Noise Steering: Exploiting Wake Steering and Acoustic Directivity for Noise-Constrained Wind Farm Control via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing noise mitigation strategies for wind farms usually consist in reducing turbines power output, without accounting for the wake interactions between them and the noise emission directivity. This leads to over-conservative policies and unexploited wind power. Yet, turbine yaw can simultaneously affect wake interactions and the direction of noise emission, offering an additional degree of freedom for farm-level noise control. We therefore propose Noise Steering, a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) strategy that jointly controls turbine yaw angles and power setpoints to maximise farm power while satisfying a local noise constraint in a defined region. To enable training at a reduced computational cost, a low-fidelity acoustic model is coupled with the steady-state FLORIS simulator. The RL agent effectively learns how to redirect wakes and noise directivity away from the protected region while redistributing power across the farm

translated_title: 噪声转向：利用尾流转向与声学指向性，通过强化学习实现噪声约束下的风电场控制
translated_abstract: 现有的风电场降噪策略通常通过降低风机功率输出来实现，而未考虑风机之间的尾流相互作用以及噪声发射的指向性，这导致了过于保守的策略和未被充分利用的风能。然而，风机偏航可以同时影响尾流相互作用和噪声发射方向，为风电场级噪声控制提供了额外的自由度。因此，我们提出了Noise Steering（噪声转向），这是一种无模型强化学习策略，通过联合控制风机偏航角和功率设定值，在满足特定区域局部噪声约束的同时最大化风电场功率。为了以较低的计算成本进行训练，我们将低保真声学模型与稳态FLORIS仿真器相结合。强化学习智能体有效地学会了如何将尾流和噪声指向性从受保护区域转移开，同时在风电场内重新分配功率。
tldr: 提出Noise Steering无模型强化学习策略，通过联合控制风机偏航角与功率设定值，同时利用尾流转向和噪声指向性，在满足局部噪声约束的条件下最大化风电场发电功率。
en_tdlr: Proposes Noise Steering, a model-free reinforcement learning strategy that jointly controls turbine yaw angles and power setpoints to exploit wake steering and acoustic directivity, maximizing wind farm power while satisfying local noise constraints.
